leverage_rationale: Contract analysis is a strong agent-native use case: structured extraction, clause inspection, comparison, and explanation benefit from direct tools more than chat-only interaction.
leverage_evidence: Submission describes tools for reading contracts, retrieving findings, comparing agreements, inspecting clauses, and explaining results.
Live page visibly accepts pasted text and document files.
execution_rationale: The live contract-review workspace loaded and its purpose and inputs were clear, but the sample-load action did not visibly populate text and the analysis workflow was not completed.
execution_evidence: Live observation: clean contract review page with text/file inputs.
Load sample produced no visible sample text in the accessibility snapshot.
impact_rationale: Helping people understand leases, job offers, and service agreements before signing has meaningful individual financial and legal consequences.
impact_evidence: Submission identifies contract terms affecting housing, income, obligations, renewal, termination, and liability.
creativity_rationale: The combination of practical clause findings, quotations, severity/confidence, scoring, and agent comparison is a thoughtful application beyond generic document chat.
creativity_evidence: Submission specifies quoted findings, section context, severity, confidence, review score, and comparison tools.
s2_notes: Purpose and WebMCP fit are credible; central end-to-end analysis was only partially observed.
advance_reason: Strong leverage and impact with a recognizable live product, despite incomplete observed workflow.

leverage_rationale: Music arrangement is well suited to agent tools that manipulate discrete notes, drum sounds, timelines, and editable parameters while leaving the human in control.
leverage_evidence: Submission emphasizes arranging individual sound units rather than receiving an opaque generated audio file.
Live editor exposes timeline, instruments, Add to Timeline, and playback controls.
execution_rationale: New project opened directly into a coherent composition editor without login, demonstrating the central creation workflow at a meaningful level.
execution_evidence: Live observation: New project succeeded and opened the composition editor.
Editor showed timeline, instrument selection, add-to-timeline, and playback.
impact_rationale: Accessible collaborative composition can help beginners, hobbyists, and creators produce editable instrumentals quickly, though the consequence level is mainly creative/productivity benefit.
impact_evidence: Submission identifies beginners, indie artists, content creators, and hobbyists as beneficiaries.
creativity_rationale: Using WebMCP to arrange atomic musical units with a human rather than generating an uneditable black-box track is an unusually strong and specific concept.
creativity_evidence: Submission explicitly contrasts editable agent collaboration with rigid generative audio.
Live editor presents a concrete instrument/timeline model.
s2_notes: The live editor was directly reached and matched the claimed collaborative music-studio concept; agent-specific calls were not independently exercised.
advance_reason: High leverage, creativity, and solid observed execution.

leverage_rationale: A shared queue directly maps agent autonomy to human prioritization, constraints, approvals, and decision pauses; WebMCP is central to the proposed control-plane interaction.
leverage_evidence: Submission defines Backlog, Working, Needs Decision, and Done states with agent execution and human oversight.
Live workspace exposes scheduling, workboards, delays, loops, queueing, and run history.
execution_rationale: The orchestration board loaded with a preloaded demo flow and coherent controls, but creating a new flow did not visibly complete.
execution_evidence: Live observation: Symbiosis work orchestration board with preloaded Hackathon flow.
New flow action was only partial and no obvious new card appeared.
impact_rationale: A persistent human-agent workload control plane could improve oversight and safe delegation across many ongoing tasks.
impact_evidence: Submission frames the problem as managing priorities, boundaries, human judgment, progress, and results across ongoing workloads.
creativity_rationale: The explicit agent-executes/human-oversees division and decision-state workflow is a more operationally specific model than a generic task manager.
creativity_evidence: Submission specifies agent pauses for decisions and shared visible state transitions.
s2_notes: Strong concept and visible workspace; central run/approval loop was not completed in observation.
advance_reason: Exceptional leverage and broad impact justify advancement despite partial execution evidence.

leverage_rationale: An agent that can guide or perform repetitive RPG actions through the same game functions is a compelling use of WebMCP for complex interactive software.
leverage_evidence: Submission describes agent quest guidance, overlays, planning, and grinding via the same functions used by the UI.
Submission describes generated agent-queryable game documentation.
execution_rationale: The page loaded but exposed no usable interactive controls in the observation, so gameplay and agent-assisted actions could not be verified.
execution_evidence: Live observation found only a title and no interactive accessibility elements.
No gameplay workflow was exercised.
impact_rationale: Agent companionship and accessibility for players with limited time could broaden participation, but impact is primarily entertainment and convenience.
impact_evidence: Submission describes guide, overlay, and grind assistance for players.
creativity_rationale: Making botting an intentional game mechanic while supporting an agent as either guide or player is a distinctive framing.
creativity_evidence: Submission explicitly contrasts its design with games that fight bots and instead builds botting into the game.
s2_notes: Strong stated concept but the live page was not operationally observable.
advance_reason: Central execution could not be verified and the observed page offered no usable workflow.

leverage_rationale: Agent-native access to holding, receiving, spending, saving, and managing stablecoin funds is a consequential domain where structured tools can enable actions beyond conversational advice.
leverage_evidence: Submission describes autonomous USDC wallet and financial-management capabilities.

execution_evidence: Live observation: Corre landing page with yield earning and capital-market products.

leverage_rationale: Collaborative shopping with live UI grounding and human checkout validation is a direct, appropriate WebMCP use case for search, comparison, cart construction, and approval.
leverage_evidence: Submission describes agent and shopper sharing a session with a human-in-the-loop checkout gate.
Live storefront shows searchable products and an agent-shopping entry point.
execution_rationale: The storefront and catalogue were visible, but the attempted product interaction did not navigate or change the cart, leaving the central shopping flow incomplete.
execution_evidence: Live observation: catalogue, filters, prices, and empty cart were visible.
Trailblazer Runner click produced no visible detail or cart change.
impact_rationale: Agent-assisted shopping with explicit human approval could reduce friction while preserving user control, though the domain is common commerce.
impact_evidence: Submission describes the agent handling the tedious search/comparison portion and requiring human checkout validation.
creativity_rationale: The live-grounding and secure sign-off framing is more thoughtful than a generic storefront chatbot.
creativity_evidence: Submission emphasizes same-session UI grounding and human-in-the-loop checkout validations.
s2_notes: Clear storefront and agent framing, but cart/checkout behavior did not visibly complete.
advance_reason: Good leverage and safety design, with enough live product evidence despite incomplete interaction.

leverage_rationale: A 224-parameter synthesizer is exactly the kind of complex visual/audio interface where named WebMCP controls and bulk edits outperform pixel-based agent interaction.
leverage_evidence: Submission describes named parameter ranges, bulk edits, playback, audio analysis, undo, and teaching workflows.
Live page visibly presents a dense wavetable synthesizer and AI activity affordance.
execution_rationale: The synth loaded as a coherent instrument editor, but the attempted preset action did not change visible state and conversational sound-design behavior was not observed.
execution_evidence: Live observation: dense wavetable synth with many controls and AI-ready activity control.
Next preset produced no visible change.
impact_rationale: This could make sophisticated sound design more accessible while preserving learning and manual control for musicians and beginners.
impact_evidence: Submission describes starting from an AI-proposed sound, inspecting exact changes, tweaking, undoing, and learning controls.
creativity_rationale: Combining agent manipulation, visible parameter provenance, and machine-readable audio feedback is highly distinctive for WebMCP.
creativity_evidence: Submission claims the agent receives attack, decay, spectral centroid, and harmonics to compare generated sound with a reference.
s2_notes: Exceptional WebMCP fit and concept; only the instrument shell was confirmed live, not the full agent/audio loop.
advance_reason: Very high leverage and creativity with a coherent live instrument, though agent behavior remains partially unverified.

leverage_rationale: Invoice matching, duplicate detection, evidence highlighting, and human countersign are structured operations where direct tools and explicit approval boundaries are materially better than chat.
leverage_evidence: Submission specifies 13 narrow tools, field evidence, audit logs, comments, and a two-phase countersign.
Live invoice detail exposed matching, duplicate, issue, comment, and decision controls.
execution_rationale: The queue opened an invoice into a coherent detailed review screen with extracted fields, confidence values, and the claimed action controls.
execution_evidence: Live observation: invoice queue and INV-10231 detail opened successfully.
Detail showed Run match, Find duplicates, Flag issue, Comment, and Request decision.
impact_rationale: Preventing duplicate or erroneous invoice approvals and preserving an audit trail addresses high-volume, financially consequential business work.
impact_evidence: Submission describes three-way matching, planted discrepancies, approval gating, and audit records.
creativity_rationale: The combination of agent automation, document-grounded evidence, adversarial invoice text, and an approval call that waits for a human is unusually well designed.
creativity_evidence: Submission describes the tool-call-to-human-click-to-agent resolver loop and explicit blue/green audit attribution.
s2_notes: Strongest observed packet: the central review workspace and consequential controls were directly visible, though no countersign was executed.
advance_reason: High scores across all criteria and strong direct runtime evidence.

leverage_rationale: The proposal makes WebMCP a control boundary for agent invoice review while reserving approval for a human, which is a strong fit for consequential workflow automation.
leverage_evidence: Submission describes matching, duplicate search, vendor checks, evidence highlights, comments, and countersign tools.
Live invoice detail exposed matching, duplicate, issue, comment, and decision controls.
execution_rationale: The same live Countersign workflow opened an invoice and exposed a coherent review screen with extracted values and the claimed review actions.
execution_evidence: Live observation: first invoice opened successfully.
Invoice fields with confidence values and review controls were visible.
impact_rationale: Invoice errors and segregation-of-duties failures carry direct financial and operational consequences; human countersign and auditability address that risk.
impact_evidence: Submission explicitly frames duplicate approval as a segregation-of-duties failure with financial cost.
creativity_rationale: The agent-proposes/human-countersigns model, evidence-localized scans, and shared audit record are distinctive and practical.
creativity_evidence: Submission defines a human approval gate and records both agent calls and reviewer clicks.
s2_notes: Directly observed coherent review workflow; actual approval wait/click was not exercised.
advance_reason: Strong consequential use case with direct live evidence of the core review surface.

leverage_rationale: Insurance appeal work benefits from agent reading, deadline checking, drafting, and tiered permissions, especially when untrusted insurer content must not control the agent.
leverage_evidence: Submission describes read/write/consent capability tiers and an agent that decodes denials, checks windows, and drafts appeals.
Live claims dashboard showed denial correspondence marked untrusted and an appeal area.
execution_rationale: The claims workspace and untrusted correspondence were visible, but no agent draft or appeal workflow was produced and the page reported WebMCP not detected.
execution_evidence: Live observation: denied claim detail and appeal-letter area loaded.
No visible agent activity or drafted appeal; WebMCP not detected.
impact_rationale: Helping people appeal denied health claims and avoid missed deadlines can materially affect access to care and financial burden.
impact_evidence: Submission focuses on denial-code interpretation, appeal windows, evidence, and drafting for people who otherwise do not appeal.
creativity_rationale: Treating hostile document text as untrusted and making safety depend on capability tiers rather than agent judgment is a distinctive, important design response.
creativity_evidence: Submission explicitly says the workspace avoids making agent safety load-bearing and uses tiered capabilities.
s2_notes: The product context and safety model were visible, but the central agent-assisted appeal behavior was not verified and WebMCP was reported absent.
